newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares inch lower on moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares inch lower on moderate trade.

text.p: The Estonian bourse was sluggish with moderate volumes on Thursday and is expected to stay that way on Friday, dealers said.
However, they added that more action was expected next week.
Total volume on the official list was 64.0 million kroons and the index closed 1.26 percent lower on 247.61.
"Most stocks seem to have found some support and are holding their prices but investors still do not have the courage to push the market to see which way it will move," one trader said.
"Investors should get more courage next week and we should see some clear direction then," he added.
Hansapank was the most active with 18.5 million kroons of shares changing hands to be three kroons lower on 253.00 kroons.
"Most of the banking stocks seems to have found some support levels and these look firm for this week," another dealer said.
Hoiupank turned over 16.8 million kroons of shares to end 0.70 kroons lower on 125.30 kroons.
On the free market, total trade was a slow 2.8 million kroons of shares with confectioner Kalev the most traded stock.
Kalev saw trade of 0.8 million kroons of shares to drop 20 kroons to 1,730 kroons.
"The free market is reflecting the mood of the main list with little movement and most prices holding or easing slightly," another trader said.
